name: ptrace-traceme
why: ptrace(PTRACE_TRACEME, a0=0) is the anti-debug self-trace this rule anchors on
source: synthetic: shape of normalize() output for ptrace_traceme_behavioral.c's TRACEME record

name: ptrace-traceme-packer
why: a packed/obfuscated binary self-tracing to block a debugger is the same primitive from a different process
source: synthetic: a packed binary issuing PTRACE_TRACEME

name: ptrace-attach
why: ptrace(PTRACE_ATTACH, a0=0x10) is process injection, not self-trace; the rule description distinguishes the two, so the a0=0 request must be load-bearing
source: synthetic: a debugger/injector attaching to another process

name: ptrace-cont
why: ptrace(PTRACE_CONT, a0=7) is what the atomic's parent tracer issues to resume the child; it is not a TRACEME and must not fire
source: synthetic: the parent tracer's PTRACE_CONT in the ptrace atomic

name: close-noise
why: an unrelated close() (not ptrace, and its a0 fd is not request 0): a sanity floor that must stay quiet
